project.name: OpenDating
project.tagline: Private dating without precise location tracking
project.description: A live browser dating app built around deliberate introductions, coarse location, private decisions, and end-to-end encrypted direct messages. Native clients remain pre-release.
differentiators: No email address or phone number required to create an account
Browser recovery keys are encrypted locally behind a user-chosen passphrase
Raw coordinates are converted on-device to a 5-character geohash
Private likes — one-way likes are never public
Private blocks and reports — enforced server-side, never notified
Current discovery and matching services are first-party
The web app is live; native store distribution remains pre-release

android._comment: local:false builds in the cloud, so android-submit resolves the artifact with --latest instead of a path. The Android SDK on this machine lives on an exFAT volume whose AppleDouble sidecars break CMake globs, which is a second reason to prefer cloud.

blog._comment: mode 'expo-public' renders static HTML into public/blog/ for EAS export; the secondary Pages copy carries canonical links back to EAS.

seo._comment: Manual, version-controlled articles only. Re-enable generation deliberately; generated files still default to drafts.
